test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a division of National Sample Survey Organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Development Agenda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **NSSO (National Sample Survey Organisation) **consists of **four divisions**- 

 
 
• **The Survey Design and Research Division (SDRD)**
 
• **The Field Operations Division (FOD)**
 
• **The Data Processing Division (DPD)**
 
• **The Coordination and Publication Division (CPD).**
 
 
 
• The** NSSO **comes under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation. **
 
• The **NSSO **functions under the overall direction of a Governing Council.
 
• In addition to the **non-official Chairman**, the** Governing Council** is composed of** five academicians, five data users **from Central and State Government departments, and **senior officers of the Ministry.**
 
• The** NSSO is headed by the Director-General** and** Chief Executive Officer** (DG&CEO) who is also the Member-Secretary of the Governing Council.
